precision: macro mean of observed positive hits/K over users with at least one target in that population
recall: macro mean of observed positive hits/number of positive targets in that population; users without a positive target excluded
ndcg: macro mean DCG/IDCG over positive-target users; rating gains 1-3=0, 4=1, 5=2; ideal computed within the population
candidate_rule: reuse fixed full-catalog top-50 lists, exclude only training-rated recipes; targets in other test populations remain candidates and have zero observed gain for the current population
selection_rule: reuse and verify existing validation-selected parameters; no new hyperparameter search after original test access
result_scope: descriptive split accuracy only; no interpretation or inference
